title: Per-profile policy declarations v1 (routing-calibration decision 11)
description: A labeled E1 evidence addition: the executed registry's per-profile policy declarations — capability tier and roles — persisted with the evidence set so tier resolution (the false-downgrade safety baseline) reads persisted, source-bound declarations instead of guessing from an opaque registry digest.
